subject: Purchase ops pathway: private offer acceptance + billing & procurement cadence
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@lumencorp.com>, Procurement Team <procure@lumencorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP draft & private offer next steps

Hi Samantha and team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached is a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) I promised — it focuses on the private offer acceptance, procurement checkpoints, and the expected billing onramp. High-level ask: please review sections 2 and 3 (approval owners and target dates) and confirm whether Lumencorp needs a PO before AWS will accept the private offer.

Key proposed milestones in the doc:
- Legal review complete (Lumencorp) — target: 2028-07-27
- Procurement issues PO / sign AMP — target: 2028-08-03
- AWS private offer accepted and billing enabled — target: 2028-08-07
- Initial test run (staged workload) — target: 2028-08-09

If you’d rather a short mutual checklist instead of the PDF I attached, we can move it into a shared Google Sheet. Also looping in Karthik to confirm the private offer payload we’ll send to AWS (pricing SKU + invoice metadata).

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Lumencorp_MAP_v2.pdf, aws_private_offer_instructions.txt

From: Samantha Wu <samantha@lumencorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@lumencorp.com>, Eric Low <eric.low@lumencorp.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft & private offer next steps

Hi Neha — thanks for sending. I reviewed the MAP with our procurement lead. A few clarifications:

1) Procurement will require a completed SOW + PO to onboard billing in AWS Marketplace. We can accept the private offer before the PO if Redwood is comfortable, but our finance policy prefers PO-first.
2) Legal flagged one clause about data residency in section 4 — Eric will propose redlines by 2028-07-26.
3) Can you confirm whether Redwood can set invoice metadata (customer_number field) so our ERP matches the Marketplace invoice?

I'll ask procurement to confirm internal approvers and send a short note with the exact PO template they need.

Thanks,
Samantha

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Initial MAP draft & private offer next steps

Quick update from our side after reviewing AWS requirements:
- AWS will allow the private offer to be published without a PO attached; however, Lumencorp billing on the marketplace will only be enabled after AWS receives confirmation that the customer (Lumencorp) has an internal PO or payment method on file.
- We can stagger the acceptance: publish private offer (to lock price/SKU) -> Lumencorp issues PO -> AWS enables billing. That sequence preserves pricing while respecting Lumencorp process.

Regarding invoice metadata: yes, we can set the invoice customer_number field and pass Lumencorp's ERP identifier in the offer payload. Marissa, can you confirm the exact field name we typically send?

—Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@lumencorp.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 10:46:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Initial MAP draft & private offer next steps

Samantha —

We typically include two invoice-level fields in the marketplace payload: 
- customer_reference_id (string) -> maps to ERP customer number
- external_billing_note (string) -> freeform note that appears on invoice

I'll attach a snippet of the payload and a short checklist for PO fields. If Lumencorp would like, we can also send a pre-filled PO template. Attached: PO_Template_Lumencorp.docx (fillable).

Next suggested milestones (adjusted):
- 2028-07-26: Lumencorp legal returns redlines (Eric) — status: pending (we didn't get redlines yet)
- 2028-07-30: Redwood to submit private offer to AWS (publish)
- 2028-08-02: Lumencorp issues PO to enable billing
- 2028-08-07: Billing active / first invoice cycle

Marissa
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Eric Low <eric.low@lumencorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Wu <samantha@lumencorp.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@lumencorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Lumencorp redlines and one question on SLA

Neha / Samantha,

Attached are our redlines to the MAP and the draft terms. Two quick items:
1) We request a 60-day invoice dispute window instead of 30 days — is that acceptable?
2) Section 5 refers to an availability SLA tied to throughput SLOs. Can Redwood confirm whether the dedicated capacity SLA applies to private offer billing (we may need an explicit note to escalate to Dedicated if SLA is a requirement).

I'll route the doc through procurement on Monday.

Eric Low
Senior Counsel, Lumencorp

Attachments: Lumencorp_redlines-markup.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Wu <samantha@lumencorp.com>, Eric Low <eric.low@lumencorp.com>, Procurement Team <procure@lumencorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumencorp redlines and one question on SLA

Thanks Eric — appreciate the quick review. Short answers:
- 60-day dispute window: acceptable; we can update the MAP and the PO template to reflect that.
- SLA and Dedicated capacity: yes — the private offer can be linked to a Dedicated commitment, and we will include a note in the MAP about escalation to Dedicated for SLA guarantees. Jordan (CS Lead) will own the escalation process and will coordinate with Lumencorp on capacity sizing.

Next concrete items from Redwood:
1) Update MAP PDF with 60-day dispute window and dedicated-escalation language (we will send updated MAP by 2028-07-30).
2) Marissa to populate the marketplace payload fields (customer_reference_id) and share the payload snippet with Lumencorp and AWS contact.
3) Neha to confirm publish date with AWS once Lumencorp confirms PO timeline.

Samantha — can procurement confirm if they will sign the PO by 2028-08-02 if we publish the private offer on 2028-07-30? If not, tell us the earliest PO date and we’ll adjust the MAP milestones.

-Neha

--
